qa_rubric.dual_ai_reported_criterion: mean(primary, secondary) when both evaluation_status=evaluated; else null
qa_rubric.dual_ai_reported_overall: mean of the four dual-AI reported criteria
qa_rubric.disagreement: true if any criterion differs by >= 1; still use the mean; never max()

citation_metrics.unit_displayed: unique displayed citation_id values on the answer (document_id::chunk_index)
citation_metrics.answer_level_citations: ASKa-Piyu currently displays sources at answer level; every claim on that answer inherits the answer displayed_citation_ids

citation_precision.numerator: unique displayed citation_ids that support at least one requires_citation claim (citation_relevance=supports for that pair)
citation_precision.denominator: unique displayed citation_ids including unresolved and wrong_document ids

citation_completeness.numerator: requires_citation claims with at least one supporting displayed citation_id

claim_support_rate.not_assessable: counted in the denominator only, never as supported or unsupported

unsupported_claim_rate.not_assessable: counted in the denominator only, never as supported or unsupported

citation_validity_rate.numerator: unique displayed citation_ids with citation_validity=valid (resolves to a chunk in the 691-chunk evaluation corpus)
citation_validity_rate.denominator: unique displayed citation_ids including unresolved and wrong_document ids

claim_statuses.supported: citation-required claim backed by at least one displayed citation
claim_statuses.unsupported: citation-required claim not backed by displayed citation evidence
claim_statuses.not_assessable: support cannot be determined; counted in claim-level denominators only

status_definitions.ok: Answer capture completed. This does not establish answer correctness.
status_definitions.oos_or_refusal: Refusal or out-of-scope handling completed. Counts as execution completion, not as a correct answer.
status_definitions.incomplete: Capture did not complete or produced an incomplete result.

execution.case_count: all unique case_ids in the run, including failed executions
execution.retry_policy: Stage 2 keeps one final execution record per case_id per run. Duplicate case_ids are rejected, not overwritten. Retry history is not supported; a later stage must add a distinct attempt/execution identifier if attempts are retained. Completion rate uses those unique cases and does not treat retries as extra dataset cases.
